title: RoPE rotary position embedding complex phase wrap-around at 131,072 context length
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0791: RoPE rotary position embedding complex phase wrap-around at 131,072 context length
Repository: `google/jax`
Category: `Numerical Stability & Tensor Geometry`
Target File: `jax/nn/rotary_embedding.py`

#### Problem Description
FP32 trigonometric phase angle theta * position loses fractional precision causing attention score degradation.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Compute position phases in float64 before casting to target activation precision.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0791.py -q`
expected_invariant: Compute position phases in float64 before casting to target activation precision.
